decision_conditions:
This application needs to remain as a Householderas some of the proposed works do not relate to the original permission.

We have amended description of development, please confirm you agree?
'Single storey rear extension with timber lantern roof and a raised patio (250mm). Single storey side extension. Removal of the rearmost chimney on the two-storey outrigger. Replacing the rainwater drainage pipes with metal fittings. New roof and replacement doors to the existing single storey outrigger. Replace existing windows with sash timber windows. One first floor window cill raised and one bay window removed and replaced with new timber frame obscure glazed window. Existing brick wall to be re-built like for like.'
